plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve lactate threshold and running economy.
Features a longer long run to build endurance and trail-specific durability.
Provides a more varied training stimulus, promoting more well-rounded development.
plan_b_advantages: May be suitable for a complete beginner or someone returning from injury due to its low intensity.
The focus on easy runs could be beneficial for active recovery in certain circumstances.
reasoning: While both plans incorporate a rest day and aim for a total training time of around 4 hours, Plan A is significantly better suited for a trail runner looking to improve speed. Plan A includes a tempo run, which is crucial for developing lactate threshold and improving running economy at faster paces. The longer long run in Plan A also contributes to building endurance and trail-specific durability, essential for tackling longer and more challenging trail races. Plan B, consisting solely of easy runs, lacks the intensity needed to drive significant performance gains.
